supplemental_items.interpretation: Repair through equals visible end main open plus chronology timeframe minus one second. Build repair finder with lower index, local_datetime, epoch and inclusive through parameter. raw_timeframe defaults to 1 only if attribute absent. closed_through is lesser of epoch(through)+1 and last available seconds candle epoch+raw_timeframe. StopAll callback compares decisionTime+args.timeframe<=closed_through; equality closed. Iterate directions and each calculationSegments or absent singleton tuple, call apply_true_false with shared finder and callback. Merged rows may share references; this local path does not separately rebuild aggregate arrays. Phase timings rounded to two decimals; total measured as elapsed perf_counter seconds times 1000 then rounded, not price rounding.
